paragraphs: Here is a guide for your English test on Friday. The test has three parts: a quiz, a short article, and a small project.

For the quiz, please review your notebook and your textbook. Write key words in your notebook and underline important sentences. For the article, read the passage once and circle the heading before you answer.
The project is a group survey. You and your partner need to make five questions and interview three classmates. Then you write a short composition about the results.
Remember to bring a pencil and fill in the blanks on the answer sheet. Good luck on your test!

paragraphs: Last week, we had a big presentation in our class. I was very nervous before it. My teacher asked us to give a short talk about a project we did.
My project was about our school library. I did a survey and interviewed the librarian. I wrote an article and made a few pictures for it.
On the day of the presentation, I took a deep breath and spoke slowly. My classmates listened carefully. When I finished, they clapped loudly. My teacher was proud of me.
After class, my friend asked me, "Why were you so nervous? You did a great job!" I smiled and said, "Because I practiced a lot, and it helped."

opts: Because it was his first big talk.

paragraphs: Do you want to write a good composition? Here are some easy steps.
First, choose a clear title. The title tells the reader what your passage is about. Then write a short paragraph for the beginning. In the beginning, answer the question "What is my article about?"
Second, write two or three body paragraphs. Use headings to separate your ideas. Remember to underline the key sentence in each paragraph. Do not use too many blanks in your writing.
Finally, write a short end. Circle the main idea and check your brackets for any mistakes. Practice writing one paragraph every day, and your writing will improve a lot.

How many body paragraphs should you write?
What should you do with the key sentence in each paragraph?
What should you do at the end of the passage?
What is the passage mainly about?

sa.title: 阅读表达
sa.绑定: 学习策略 / 疑问词 / 复习诊断
paragraphs: A Busy Study Week
This week, our class did a big review for the English test. On Monday, we did a quiz about verbs. On Tuesday, we read a passage and answered questions.
On Wednesday, we worked on a group project. We made a survey about our favorite subjects. I interviewed four classmates and wrote an article about the results.
On Thursday, we checked our notebooks and underlined the important sentences. On Friday, we had the test. I was a little nervous, but I felt ready.
After the test, my teacher said, "Why did you do so well?" I said, "Because I practiced every day."

questions.answer: They did a quiz about verbs.

writing.title: 书面表达
writing.prompt:
假如你是李华，请你用英语写一篇100词左右的短文，介绍你一次参加测试或课题的经历。内容包括：
1. 你参加了什么测试或课题、在什么时候；
2. 你做了什么准备（用 notebook/textbook/underline 等学习工具类词汇）；
3. 结果怎么样、你的感受是什么。
sample: Last month, I had a big English test at school. I was nervous, so I prepared carefully.
I opened my textbook and notebook every day. I underlined the important sentences and circled the key words. I read the passage again and again. I also practiced writing a short composition.
On the day of the test, I was a little worried, but I did my best. When the result came, I was very happy because I got a good grade. I learned that hard work helps a lot.
writing.requirements: 1. 词数约 100 词；2. 包含所有提示要点；3. 语句通顺，意思连贯，语法正确；4. 可适当发挥。
